svg.text: #595 Milestone: Enterprise Post-Training (Full SFT vs. LoRA vs. GRPO RL) & Shared Cluster Sizing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 16 Bytes/Param Full-SFT (1,120GB) vs. LoRA (156GB) · GRPO Saves 42% RL VRAM vs. PPO · Overnight vLLM Rollout
1. 70B Post-Training VRAM Hand-Calculation Formulas
A. Full-Parameter SFT / CPT (BF16 Mixed Precision + FP32 AdamW)
• Static States = 2B(W) + 2B(Grad) + 12B(FP32 Master + m,v) = 16 Bytes/param
• 70B × 16B = 1,120 GB + Activations → Requires 16× H100 (2 Nodes + RDMA)
B. LoRA (r=32, BF16 Frozen Base) — Single-Node Zero-RDMA Sweet Spot
• Frozen Base (70B × 2B = 140 GB) + Trainable LoRA States (3.2 GB) + Act = 156 GB
• Fits on 2× H200-141GB or 4× H100-80GB (Single Node · 0 RDMA Switches · -75% GPUs!)
C. GRPO Reinforcement Learning (veRL / OpenRLHF) vs. Legacy PPO
• PPO requires Actor + Ref + Critic + Reward (4× 70B models in memory = 32× H100)
• GRPO drops Critic & uses Rule Verifiers + LoRA Actor → 8× H200 (-75% RL Fleet!)
2. Why 82% of GRPO RL Time Is Actually vLLM Inference!
The GRPO Rollout Bottleneck (Group Size G = 8 Rollouts × 4K Tokens)
• Generating G=8 long Chain-of-Thought completions per prompt consumes 82% of step time
• veRL / slime HybridEngine co-schedules vLLM Rollout on idle nighttime inference GPUs
• Only 18% of step time is spent in FSDP2 backward/optimizer gradient updates
• Eliminates the need to buy a separate dedicated 16-GPU RL training cluster!

3. Enterprise Post-Training Selection Decision Rule
• 90% of enterprise domain/format adaptation succeeds with LoRA r=32 SFT on a single 4×H100 / 2×H200 node ($0 RDMA fabric required).
• For SQL/Code/Math reasoning boosts, run GRPO with deterministic AST/unit-test verifiers on overnight borrowed H200 nodes.
